name: Genitofemoral Neuralgia
definition: Neuropathic pain in the genitofemoral nerve distribution involving groin, upper anterior thigh and genital region, often following surgery or retroperitoneal injury.

investigations.principle: Clinical localization is primary; imaging and diagnostic blocks are selected by suspected cause.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent focal entrapment may require specialist nerve intervention.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vankshana Vata-neuralgic phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Neuropathic pain in the genitofemoral nerve distribution involving groin, upper anterior thigh and genital region, often following surgery or retroperitoneal injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
